subject: Lumify Health — structured output QA runbook & next steps
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Torres <emily@lumifyhealth.com>, Jordan Bates <jbates@lumifyhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Lumify Health — post-demo: structured output QA runbook & next steps

Hi Emily / Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Short recap and suggested next steps so we have a single runbook for the evaluation phase:

- Objective: validate structured JSON output for Lumify's ingestion pipeline (billing_id, patient_reference, event_type, timestamps) and ensure robust retry semantics when partial failures occur.
- Recommended models to test (initial): Llama-3-70B-qat (quantized), Redwood-lt-medium (4-bit), and a smaller low-latency option (redstone-7b) for baseline throughput comparisons.
- Deliverables we propose: conformance checklist, benchmark CSV (latency/QPS/errors), prompt set + expected output examples, and a failing-case corpus.

Ask from your side: can you share a small, redacted sample of real payloads (<= 500 rows) that include the edge cases you care about (missing billing_id, multi-value patient refs, timezone variants)? We will only use these to craft expected-schema examples.

Attachments: lumify_prompt_suite_v1.jsonl, lumify_bench_targets_v0.3.csv, structured-output-testplan.md, example_payloads_sample.zip (placeholder).

Proposed timeline: initial conformance run by 2028-11-08, follow-up review w/ results 2028-11-10.

I'll loop Neha to lead the evals and Ben to own ingestion/connectivity. If that timeline works, we can kick off with a quick 30-min alignment call next week.

Best,
Monica
Monica Patel
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Monica —

Thanks for the clear summary. We can share a single redacted export (customer_events.jsonl) tomorrow morning. Two high-priority points for the evaluation:

1) billing_id is critical — if the model emits anything other than a 10-digit numeric ID we need deterministic rejection (we can provide the regex).
2) Retry behavior: our ingestion pipeline retries on 5xx and network errors; we need to confirm Redwood's retry semantics for partial responses and idempotency tokens.

Jordan and I can join the 30-min call; tentative availability Tues/Wed next week.

Emily Torres
Head of Integrations, Lumify Health
emily@lumifyhealth.com

Subject: Re: Lumify Health — structured output QA runbook & next steps

Emily — great, thanks. Regex for billing_id and the redacted sample will be enough for our first pass.

Internal plan (summary for transparency):
- Neha: own schema conformance and regression checks. Run three test stages: (A) strict schema validation (JSON Schema v7) across 500 examples; (B) fuzzing and edge-case generation focused on missing fields and multi-value patient_reference; (C) retry/resilience simulation with injected 5xx and partial streaming interruptions.
- Ben: set up a lightweight ingestion harness that mimics your retry logic and idempotency tokens. We'll run the harness against the model variants so we capture true end-to-end behavior.
- Monica: coordinate and produce a single artifacts bundle (benchmarks + failing examples) and host results in the shared Drive link.

Model/quantization suggestions: start with Llama-3-70B-qat (highest quality), Redwood-lt-medium (balanced), redstone-7b (baseline latency). For schema-sensitive fields we will also try constrained decoding with token-level white/blacklists and prompt-level validation + fallback.

Deliverables & milestones: initial conformance CSV by 2028-11-08, full artifact bundle and recommendations by 2028-11-15.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1LumifyEvalKit (working folder), https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/structured-output-qa (internal runbook).

Monica

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 10:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lumify Health — structured output QA runbook & next steps (internal)

Team —

I'll kick off the conformance suite once we have the redacted sample from Lumify. Quick operational notes:

1) Schema: I'll author a strict JSON Schema v7 file for Lumify's expected contract (billing_id: pattern ^\d{10}$; patient_reference: string|array; event_type: enum).
2) Tooling: using our Structured Output Validator (SOV) + a separate harness to simulate streaming truncation and 5xx responses. We'll capture token-level logs to diagnose why mis-parses occur.
3) Retry semantics: I'll run three types of retries — immediate short backoff, idempotent-safe retry (with token), and non-idempotent fallback (we will surface as "needs human review").
4) Reporting: CSV will include columns: example_id, expected_schema_ok (y/n), model, quant, latency_ms_p50/p95, retries_required, final_status.

I'll post interim results to the Drive folder and flag any quality regressions. If we hit >3% schema-rejection on the primary model, recommend canary rollback and tighter decoding constraints.

I'll estimate first results by COB 2028-11-08. Ben, can you confirm you can wire the ingestion harness by EOD Monday?

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Applied ML, Redwood Inference
